import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove negative and out-of-range values in flipper_length_mm
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Remove out-of-range values in body_mass_g
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Clean sex column by stripping whitespace
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
